fullContentHtml:
Short Information : Bombay High Court has release notification for the post of Personal Assistant on the official website of BHC. This recruitment has been issued for 44 posts. Online applying process for Bombay High Court Personal Assistant Recruitment 2025 has started from 18 August 2025 & the candidates can apply till 01 September 2025. Those Candidates Are Interested in the following recruitment can apply online from the link given below.

Bombay High Court

Bombay High Court Personal Assistant Recruitment 2025

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 18 August 2025
  • Last Date : 01 September 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 01 September 2025
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 1000/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

Bombay High Court Personal Assistant Notification 2025 : Age Limit

  • Age Limit As On 18 August 2025
  • Minimum Age : 21 Years
  • Maximum Age : 38 Years
  • Age Relaxation as per Bombay High Court Personal Assistant Recruitment Rules.
  • Use Tool –

Bombay High Court Personal Assistant 2025 : Vacancy Details

Total Posts : 44

Post Name No. of Posts
Personal Assistant (PA) 44

Bombay High Court Personal Assistant Recruitment 2025 : Educational Qualification

  • Candidates who have completed their Bachelor’s degree in any stream from a recognized university in India will be eligible for this recruitment
  • must have passed English Shorthand Examination of speed of 120 w.p.m. or above from Government Commercial Certificate Examination or Industrial Training Institute.
  • must have passed English Typing Examination of speed of 50 w.p.m. or above of Government Commercial Certificate Examination conducted by Maharashtra State Bureau of Examination or Government Certificate in Computer Typing Basic Course (GCC-TBC) conducted by Maharashtra State Council of Examination (MSCE) or Industrial Training Institute.

Bombay High Court Personal Assistant Online Form 2025 : How To Apply

  • Candidates can apply through link https://bombayhighcourt.nic.in/ or provided below in link section or they can also apply through official site of the Bombay High Court before Last Date.
  • You Can Check other Sarkari Result 2025 Notification Here – Check Now.
  • For all the interested and eligible candidates who want to apply for Bombay High Court Personal Assistant recruitment can read all the information related to the recruitment is given below and the link to apply is given in the Important Link section below.
  • Note – छात्रो से ये अनुरोध किया जाता है की वो अपना फॉर्म भरने से पहले Official Notification (Last Date, Age Limit, Qualification) को ध्यान से जरूर पढे उसके बाद ही अपना फॉर्म भरे ।

Bombay High Court Personal Assistant Recruitment 2025 : Mode of Selection

  • Shorthand Test (40 Marks)
  • Typing Test (40 Marks)
  • Viva-Voce (20 Marks)
  • Document Verification
  • Medical Examination
